comment_sha256.description: for kind=comment: the comment_sha256 check_file reports for the comment; an edit to a comment whose bytes differ is refused as changed

current_text.description: for kind=comment: the comment's prose as you read it, without comment markers; guards the edit when comment_sha256 is not given

do_not_translate.description: for kind=term: true keeps the term verbatim in every language, false clears that, omitted leaves it

evidence.description: for asset entries: where the wording behind this decision was seen

id.description: the block id; for kind=comment the comment's id as check_file reports it, such as func/Parse

kind.description: change kind; use content for document wording and comment for a code comment

lines.description: for kind=comment: the lines check_file reported for the comment

replacement.description: replacement term for kind=voice; content entries use text

text.description: the new wording: for kind=content the block text with the inline placeholders extract_content shows; for kind=comment the comment's prose without comment markers

width.description: for kind=comment: the column a line of prose wraps at; 0 keeps the width of the comment being rewritten, and never less than 80. The languages a comment plugin reads keep the comment's own line breaks, so width does not apply to them
